about: ASK 417 exercise registry (plan W3 a417_w3/plan_rev1.md, build W2). One entry per live package. case_sql and mark_sql are SQL expressions over the CTEs r (debate_results row of the run), j (its debate_judgments rows), e (its debate_enforcer_log rows) and x (debate_errors rows in the run window: 3 hours before r.created_at to 10 minutes after; debate_errors has no run_token). case_sql is boolean; mark_sql is a count, or null when no mark is defined. probe: 'sql', 'NOT IN DB' or 'NO PROBE'. live_since is the UTC save time of the engine version that made the package live (n8n workflow history of moMxiV4Irg1uRBZN, matched to W4's write posts).

packages.case_sql: exists(select 1 from e where e.rule='E-ASSUME' and e.item like 'CHALLENGER PREMISE%')
packages.mark_sql: (select coalesce(sum((length(coalesce(r.engine_r3,''))-length(replace(coalesce(r.engine_r3,''),'ASSUMES:','')))/8),0) from r)

packages.title: enforcer sees judges as Judge k, no seat id in label forms
packages.case_sql: exists(select 1 from e where e.kind in ('enforcer_check','send_back') and e.prompt_sent is not null)
packages.mark_sql: (select case when exists(select 1 from e where e.kind in ('enforcer_check','send_back') and e.prompt_sent ~ '(\((A[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?, )?(argon|chatgpt|deepseek|ember|gemini|glm_legal|glm|grok|haiku|hydrogen|luna|mimo|qwen|sol62|sol|sonnet|ernie|alt_minimax31|spark|claude)\)|line of (argon|chatgpt|deepseek|ember|gemini|glm_legal|glm|grok|haiku|hydrogen|luna|mimo|qwen|sol62|sol|sonnet|ernie|alt_minimax31|spark|claude)\M)') then 0 else (select count(*) from e where e.kind in ('enforcer_check','send_back') and e.prompt_sent ~ 'Judge [0-9]') end)
packages.note: Plan a429_w3/plan_rev2.md item 6 (W2 9060 C-2, W1 9065 N1). Seat ids are matched only inside label forms: a seat id alone in parentheses (optionally after an A-number and comma) or after "line of", so "remember" and "solution" never match. prompt_sent is stored only on the first row of a batch. Any labelled seat id gives 0 (MISSED); else the mark counts rows that hold "Judge k". Known-bad: 39266 --all (labels such as (chatgpt), (sol62)). Seat list: every judge_seat in debate_judgments plus enforcer and alternate seats; a new seat must be added here.

packages.title: bare verse number after a comma binds to the same chapter ("Psalms 2:7, 12 Kiss")
packages.case_sql: exists(select 1 from r, regexp_matches(concat_ws(E'\n',r.claude_r1,r.engine_r1,r.claude_r2,r.engine_r2,r.engine_r3,r.challenger_r3,r.defender_r4,r.challenger_r4), '(\m[1-3]? ?[A-Z][a-z]+) ([0-9]+):[0-9]+(?:[-–][0-9]+)?, ([0-9]+) [A-Z][a-z]+', 'g') m)
packages.mark_sql: (select count(*) from r, regexp_matches(concat_ws(E'\n',r.claude_r1,r.engine_r1,r.claude_r2,r.engine_r2,r.engine_r3,r.challenger_r3,r.defender_r4,r.challenger_r4), '(\m[1-3]? ?[A-Z][a-z]+) ([0-9]+):[0-9]+(?:[-–][0-9]+)?, ([0-9]+) [A-Z][a-z]+', 'g') m where r.citation_check::text like '%"ref": "'||m[1]||' '||m[2]||':'||m[3]||'"%')
packages.note: Plan a435_w2/plan_rev2.md item 6. Case: a full reference then ", N Word" in any round. Mark: the bound reference book c:N in citation_check items. Limits: the case does not test that N+Word is not a book ("2 Kings" after a comma is a book, not a bound verse) and an abbreviated book ("Matt") will not equal citation_check's full name; both read MISSED and are read by hand. Known-good on stored text (W4 9208): 26163 John 12:32, 24355 Isaiah 28:12, 27613, 32157; all predate the write, so --all reads them MISSED (old code).
